doc.title: Maria Schneider interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001

title: Closing and Grammy nomination
summary: Rowe proposes a follow-up in five years and congratulates her on the Grammy nomination.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. Well we’ll make a date for five years and see where we’re at.
If you’re in Rio, we’ll come down there.
Yeah, yeah. Have you been there?
Oh, talk about life changes. Yeah. Deep.
Great. Well this has really been very interesting.
And you speak as well as your music comes out I think.
And congratulations on your Nammy — Grammy nomination. Nammy Gromination.
Yeah. That’s great. And you have a great band and I’m sure they—
